030package dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate;
031
032import java.lang.System.Logger;
033import java.sql.JDBCType;
034import java.sql.SQLException;
035
036import javax.sql.RowSet;
037import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
038
039import dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.RSC;
040import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
041import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent;
042import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils;
043
044import static dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.Utils.postColumnUndoRedo;
045import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
046import static java.lang.System.Logger.Level.*;
047
048/**
049 * UndoRedo static commands.
050 */
051public enum UndoRedo {
052  /** Undo command */
053  UNDO,
054  /** Redo command */
055  REDO,
056  /** Cancel edit, clear stack */
057  ESC,
058  ;
059
060  /**
061   * Value and error status of item on the undo/redo stack.
062   * "codedValue" because a null is represented by JDBCType.NULL
063   * when rs.updateNull was used.
064   */
065  public record Change(Object codedValue, boolean isError) {
066    public Object value() {
067      return codedValue == JDBCType.NULL ? null : codedValue;
068    }
069  }
070  ;
071
072  static final Change NO_CHANGE = new Change("UNDO/REDO NONE", false);
073
074  /** Logger for component */
075  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
076
077  // UNDO/REDO NOTES
078  //
079  // Currently undo/redo can NOT be changed while running.
080  // If/when changing is supported, it should only be changed
081  // when going to a new row or insertRow. Any user interface to
082  // enable/disable undo/redo should queue the change request
083  // and then apply it during the transition to a new row.
084  //
085  // Part of undo/redo for insertRow is capturing the values set
086  // by preInsertOps; the values are captured by the undo/redo
087  // logic. So if going from disabled to enabled, the enable must
088  // come before preInsertOps.
089
090  /**
091   * Check if the specified {@linkplain RowSet} is currently enabled
092   * for undo/redo. The enable state may only change when the RowSet's
093   * current row changes.
094   * @param rs RowSet of interest
095   * @return true if undo/redo is OK
096   */
097  public static boolean isUndoRedoEnabled(RowSet rs) {
098    return true;
099    //return !get(rs).isOnInsertRow();
100  }
101
102  /**
103   * Check if the specified {@linkplain RSC} is currently enabled
104   * for undo/redo. The enable state may only change when the RowSet's
105   * current row changes.
106   * <p>
107   * This method currently delegates to check the rowset. In the future
108   * it's possible that per column enable may be implemented.
109   * @param comp RSC of interest
110   * @return true if undo/redo is OK
111   */
112  public static boolean isUndoRedoEnabled(RSC comp) {
113    return isUndoRedoEnabled(comp.getRowSet());
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Make sure the column's undo/redo stack is initialized; the
118   * database value (an object) is the base.
119   * This must be used before any updates are done to the rowset.
120   * Does nothing if base already captured.
121   * @param comp rowset/column
122   * @throws SQLException
123   */
124  public static void captureInitialValue(RSC comp) throws SQLException {
125    if (!isUndoRedoEnabled(comp))
126      return;
127    comp.getRowsModel().getUndoRow().captureInitialValue(comp);
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Return the current undo/redo value for the specified component.
132   * @param comp rowset/column
133   * @return current value
134   * @throws SQLException
135   */
136  public static Change fetchCurrentChange(RSC comp) throws SQLException {
137    if (!isUndoRedoEnabled(comp))
138      throw new IllegalStateException("UNDO/REDO disabled");
139    return comp.getRowsModel().getUndoRow().fetchCurrentChange(comp);
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * Perform the specified undo/redo cmd on the specified component.
144   * @param comp ssComponent
145   * @param cmd undo or redo
146   */
147  // TODO: SsComponent vs RSC
148  public static void undoRedo(SsComponent comp, UndoRedo cmd) {
149    if (!isUndoRedoEnabled(comp))
150      return;
151    logger.log(
152        DEBUG,
153        () -> sf("%s: %s for %s", cmd, comp.getClass().getSimpleName(), comp.getColumnName()));
154    try {
155      RowsModel rm;
156      if (comp.getColumnName() == null || (rm = comp.getRowsModel()) == null) {
157        SsUtils.beep();
158        return;
159      }
160
161      NavigateState navState = rm.getNavState();
162      Change change = navState.doUndoRedo(comp, cmd);
163      // Wait until value propogates to the component.
164      if (change != NO_CHANGE)
165        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
166          postColumnUndoRedo(comp, change.value(), change.isError /*|| !comp.allValidate().all()*/);
167        });
168    } catch (SQLException ex) {
169      logger.log(ERROR, sf("%s:", cmd), ex);
170      // TODO: error dialog?
171      //postRowSetUndoRedo(comp, UndoCol.none, true); // show error?
172    }
173  }
174
175  /**
176   * Make the next undo/redo change goes into a new slot.
177   * @param comp rowset/col
178   */
179  public static void newSlot(RSC comp) {
180    if (!isUndoRedoEnabled(comp))
181      return;
182    comp.getRowsModel().getUndoRow().focusChange(null);
183  }
184
185  /**
186   * Add a modification to the undo/redo stack.
187   * @param ev
188   * @throws SQLException
189   */
190  // TODO: make this package visibility, go through rowsModel?
191  public static void addUndoableChange(ColumnChangeStartEvent ev) throws SQLException {
192    if (!isUndoRedoEnabled(ev.getSource()))
193      return;
194    ev.getSource().getRowsModel().getUndoRow().addChange(ev);
195  }
196}
